title: Indoor Unit Communication Error
shortDescription: Outdoor board lost communication with indoor.
fullDescription: On Coleman (Johnson Controls) communicating systems, E1 means the data bus lost contact with the indoor unit.
safetyWarning: Power off at disconnects before working on wiring.

title: High Pressure Trip
fullDescription: Dirty coil, failed condenser fan, or overcharge.

title: Low Pressure Trip
fullDescription: Likely leak, iced coil, or airflow restriction.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Plug to board, clip to location.

title: Compressor Overload
fullDescription: Overheated compressor - could be HPS trip, weak cap, or failing compressor.

title: Low Line Voltage
fullDescription: Protect compressor from low voltage operation.
